import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Get the first four project heading links, assuming they are the top most starred
    project_links = page.get_by_role('heading', level=2).get_by_role('link')
    count = await project_links.count()
    
    for i in range(min(4, count)):
        # Click the project link to navigate to its page
        await project_links.nth(i).click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the project page to load
        
        # Find and click the star button on the project page
        star_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Star')
        if await star_button.count() > 0:
            await star_button.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the star action to complete
        
        # Navigate back to the projects list to continue with the next project
        await page.goto('/explore/projects/starred')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the list to reload
    
    # After starring all four, no further actions needed

import asyncio

async def act(page):

    for i in range(min(4, count)):

        # Find and click the star button on the project page
